title: How long at the Lambs and what followed
summary: The Lambs engagement lasted 16 weeks before closing for remodelling; the band then went to New York.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I might ask you about a few of those questions now. First, how long you were at LAMS in Chicago? About how many months you stayed there or weeks?
Yeah. Then they closed the place up to remodel it.
And so they said, now, you guys are on your own. Go take a job somewhere.
So we took some little board of time around there.
Then it seemed like they had a little labor trouble. And we got the wind that the place wouldn't be ready in the fall to open. So we said, let's hope this will take off.
